headline: Suffocating companies to win votes
summary: Mexico's National Minimum Wage Commission (Conasami) began permanent sessions to set the 2027 minimum wage. Proposals range from 4.8% to 18%, with no figure yet agreed.
why: Minimum wage changes affect labor costs for employers across Mexico, especially in manufacturing and retail. They also feed into inflation expectations and the central bank's policy outlook.
original_headline: Asfixiar a las empresas para ganar votos
